_doc: Allow-list for scripts/mailto_order_sweep.mjs. A row is ALLOWED only if an entry in 'allow' matches it; every entry needs a reason. 'order_pages' are route regexes where a non-allowed mailto or non-checkout order CTA FAILS the sweep. 'checkout_routes' are the internal destinations that count as checkout or signup. 'checkout_for' says, per route regex, which checkout route exists for that page (null = none exists yet).

allow.reason: Bare contact link with no subject or body: a person reaching Kyle, not a purchase intent.
RFC 9116 security.txt Contact field must be a mailto: URI.
The contact page exists to give the email address.
Shared contact widget (email plus Telegram); contact, not order.
Legal and about pages: data requests and corrections go to the named person by email.

checkout_for.checkout: productBuyHref(product) when set; none when unset
